current_state: Denied by the port operator (June 2026). Ankaran municipality alleged a tanker/LPG/LNG terminal project; Luka Koper called the claim false/misleading and says the national spatial plan only covers an upgrade of existing port capacities, with no fixed LNG infrastructure foreseen. Separately, Koper is developing ship-to-ship LNG BUNKERING capability (out of scope for this tracker regardless).
missing_threshold_elements: No sponsor commitment (actively denied); no location beyond the existing port footprint; no concrete step (permit/FID/MOU) — pure political allegation vs. denial.
watch_for: A confirmed permit filing, EIA, or FID for a genuine marine LNG import/export terminal (fixed regas/liquefaction infrastructure) at Koper or elsewhere on Slovenia's short coastline.
notes: Slovenia remains a zero-GEM-terminal coverage-gap country; its only near-term LNG access is via Croatia's Krk FSRU and Italy's Adriatic LNG terminal by pipeline, not a domestic marine terminal.
